assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: standalone high-resolution editorial website illustration, transparent PNG.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, an approved full-page homepage concept. Extract ONLY the precisely identified illustration. The surrounding website is context, not part of the asset.
Primary request: isolate and faithfully reconstruct this existing small illustration as a reusable high-resolution asset. Preserve its composition, object proportions, hand-drawn ink lines, soft watercolor shading, quiet material texture, perspective, colors and visual character. Supply genuine alpha transparency around the illustration, including softly fading watercolor edges and subtle contact shadows. White/cream book pages and solid white objects MUST remain opaque; do not confuse them with the background.
Render at the highest available native resolution, targeting 2048 by 1536 pixels, with crisp fine ink detail and softly textured paint; no nearest-neighbor enlargement and no screenshot crop. Leave modest transparent padding so nothing is clipped.
Avoid: page headlines, logos from the surrounding page, navigation, body copy, buttons, card frames, webpage backgrounds, unrelated illustrations, extra objects, watermark, border, checkerboard baked into pixels.
Subject: the freestanding desk calendar with two dark blue metal binding rings, gridded paper page with one muted amber highlighted date, slate-blue folded stand, slender dark blue pen below, and a potted leafy olive-green plant on the right. It is the FIRST product illustration, on the RIGHT of the Software page around 16–30% down.
Keep the subtle pale blue watercolor cloud and lightly sketched cream desktop beneath, fading to real alpha. Preserve the relative arrangement and slightly front-right perspective. Remove the tiny handwritten marketing sentence from the calendar's blank right panel, leaving that area clean for later localized typography. No calendar numerals or product logos.
